# Fifty Pages of Shades — Nick Brand

> Fifty Pages of Shades is the fine-art photography brand of Nick Brand, a Sydney photographer with 20+ years' experience.
> The work: contemporary black-and-white abstract photographic art exploring form, texture, light and shadow.
> The images are entirely non-explicit and often surprisingly difficult to interpret, sitting between abstract photography and contemporary fine art.
> Each work is a strictly limited edition of 15, printed on framed canvas in custom sizes, with a certificate of
> authenticity. Sold to collectors, interior designers, architects, corporate clients and healthcare facilities.
> Priced from AUD $1,700, by size and frame. Based in Sydney, Australia; delivery Australia-wide and worldwide.

## Where to see it
- Fifty Pages of Shades is showing at NITA Gallery, 68 Campbell Street, Surry Hills NSW 2010, Sydney.
- NITA Gallery hours: Tuesday and Wednesday 10am-6pm; Thursday 10am-8pm; Friday 10am-6pm; Saturday 10am-3pm; also by appointment any day.
- Private viewings for designers, corporate and healthcare buyers and collectors: phone Nick on 0403 835 467 or email studio@fiftypagesofshades.com.
- Visit details: https://www.fiftypagesofshades.com/about/exhibitions/
- NITA Gallery site: https://www.nitagallery.com.au
